data_fields.donor_constant: MONSTER_FREQUENCY by galaxy setting: low 0.03, medium 0.08, high 0.2

data_fields.name: kindRate
data_fields.donor_constant: per kind, e.g. SM_KRILL_1 0.5, SM_DRONE_FACTORY 0.4, SM_EXP_OUTPOST 1000.0

data_fields.name: kindCap
data_fields.donor_constant: per kind, e.g. SM_DRONE_FACTORY 5, SM_FLOATER 50, SM_KRILL_1 9999 (unlimited)

data_fields.name: minHops
data_fields.donor_constant: max(per-kind floor, MIN_MONSTER_DISTANCE); floors 2 to 6; rule default 3 minus 1 = 2

data_fields.name: blockerRegionsExpected
data_fields.donor_constant: placed blockers + 2 regions while the candidate is counted

best_idea: Give each spawn kind its own location rule (a hop distance from player-held zones), a cap and a rate, then pick one eligible kind per zone before a single roll, so every zone is visited once.
decision_why: Keep the per-kind table (rate, cap and location rule as zone data) and the one-kind-then-roll loop at generation; reject the runtime spawner as written because it ignores the caps and location rules and hard-codes one kind.
acceptance: Server test: 2-hop safe radius around player-held zones and cap 5 on one kind; over 500 seeded generation passes no spawn is within 2 hops of a player zone, the kind never exceeds 5, and a lane-breaking spawn that would split the zone graph beyond blockers + 1 regions is refused.
